baselineIdentity.phase: ARCH-1 — BEHAVIORAL FREEZE + CHARACTERIZATION HARNESS R1

behaviorRegistry.description: Exactly one platform in each actionable row contains the mathematically authoritative correct answer.
behaviorRegistry.observableEvidence: actionableRowPlatforms.filter(p => p.isCorrect).length === 1
behaviorRegistry.playerAcceptanceRequirement: Educational requirement: every arithmetic decision must have exactly one correct path.

behaviorRegistry.description: All candidate options on a platform row are distinct; duplicate decoy values are prohibited.
behaviorRegistry.observableEvidence: new Set(actionableRowPlatforms.map(p => p.val)).size === actionableRowPlatforms.length
behaviorRegistry.playerAcceptanceRequirement: Unambiguous choices on every platform row.

behaviorRegistry.description: Generated options for lookahead rows 1..N remain invariant as lower rows resolve.
behaviorRegistry.observableEvidence: Lookahead row options identical before and after jump resolution.
behaviorRegistry.playerAcceptanceRequirement: Answers must not shift while player evaluates them in advance.

behaviorRegistry.description: Identical seed and level produces identical math challenges.
behaviorRegistry.observableEvidence: Multi-run challenge ID and option value checksum parity.
behaviorRegistry.playerAcceptanceRequirement: Auditability and reproducible competition runs.

behaviorRegistry.description: SumToMode challenge and distractor generation for additive targets.
behaviorRegistry.observableEvidence: activeChallenge prompt matches 'Make <Target>' and answers sum correctly.
behaviorRegistry.playerAcceptanceRequirement: Target addition gameplay.

behaviorRegistry.description: DifferenceMode challenge generation and distractor generation.
behaviorRegistry.observableEvidence: Difference equation prompts and valid subtraction steps.
behaviorRegistry.playerAcceptanceRequirement: Subtraction gameplay.

behaviorRegistry.description: MultiplyMode factor generation and option uniqueness.
behaviorRegistry.observableEvidence: Multiplication table prompts with mathematically sound distractors.
behaviorRegistry.playerAcceptanceRequirement: Times-tables arcade gameplay.

behaviorRegistry.description: SkipCountMode sequence alignment and step increments.
behaviorRegistry.observableEvidence: Sequential arithmetic progressions matching configured step size.
behaviorRegistry.playerAcceptanceRequirement: Pattern recognition gameplay.

behaviorRegistry.description: Any visible pixel within the rendered platform body selects that platform.
behaviorRegistry.observableEvidence: Pointers inside visual geometry bounds result in successful platform selection.
behaviorRegistry.playerAcceptanceRequirement: Direct player requirement: whole visual platform is the hitbox.

behaviorRegistry.description: Number/text bounds do NOT restrict or participate in hitbox extent.
behaviorRegistry.observableEvidence: Platform edge selections succeed without clicking directly on text characters.
behaviorRegistry.playerAcceptanceRequirement: Selecting outer visual wings must register reliably.

behaviorRegistry.description: Modest centralized touch tolerance (8px world space) for mobile accessibility.
behaviorRegistry.observableEvidence: Touch points within 8px outside visual body register as platform hits.
behaviorRegistry.playerAcceptanceRequirement: Smooth, forgiving touch selection on mobile displays.

behaviorRegistry.description: Deterministic tie-break ordering: Visual Body > Tolerance > Distance to Center > Platform ID.
behaviorRegistry.observableEvidence: Consistent resolution when touch tolerance circles overlap.
behaviorRegistry.playerAcceptanceRequirement: Deterministic jump target selection without random choice.

behaviorRegistry.description: Wrong answer shatters platform into fragments and disables it from further selection.
behaviorRegistry.observableEvidence: platform.shattered === true and platform cannot be selected again.
behaviorRegistry.playerAcceptanceRequirement: Clear visual penalty indicating wrong choice.

behaviorRegistry.description: Duration of shatter particle animation.
behaviorRegistry.observableEvidence: Particle lifetime between 0.3s and 0.5s.
behaviorRegistry.playerAcceptanceRequirement: Visually punchy feedback without delaying gameplay rhythm.

behaviorRegistry.description: Both current and next row answer centers are framed legibly within 20px <= x <= 480px.
behaviorRegistry.observableEvidence: evaluateActionableRowFraming().isFramedCorrectly === true
behaviorRegistry.playerAcceptanceRequirement: Player must clearly see destination options before jumping.

behaviorRegistry.description: Camera tracks diagonal progression vectors (pv.x * gapY) without premature landing drift.
behaviorRegistry.observableEvidence: camera.x tracks row centers accurately during flight and stays anchored on landing.
behaviorRegistry.playerAcceptanceRequirement: Stable visual perspective on angled campaign routes.

behaviorRegistry.description: Camera interpolation lerp rates along X and Y axes.
behaviorRegistry.observableEvidence: CameraConfig lerpRateX and lerpRateY parameters.
behaviorRegistry.playerAcceptanceRequirement: Smooth tracking without motion sickness.

behaviorRegistry.description: Single authoritative physical wave crest in world space advancing along Y.
behaviorRegistry.observableEvidence: All collisions and presentation screen positions derive from state.wave.y.
behaviorRegistry.playerAcceptanceRequirement: Fair, predictable hazard movement.

behaviorRegistry.description: Viewport-relative new-level entrance placing crest offscreen until entrance window (t <= 3.0s).
behaviorRegistry.observableEvidence: Crest starts offscreen and enters viewport within 3.0s of level start.
behaviorRegistry.playerAcceptanceRequirement: Player has initial breathing room to read the first challenge.

behaviorRegistry.description: Pursuit wave advances at constant configured physical speed for the level. No speed curves, slowdowns, or rubber banding.
behaviorRegistry.observableEvidence: wave.y(t) = wave.y(0) - speed * t
behaviorRegistry.playerAcceptanceRequirement: Consistent, learnable pressure without artificial rubber banding.

behaviorRegistry.description: Configured physical pursuit speed value per level.
behaviorRegistry.observableEvidence: wave.speed property in LevelSchema.
behaviorRegistry.playerAcceptanceRequirement: Difficulty tuning per campaign sector.

behaviorRegistry.description: Viewport-relative recovery placement positioning wave 350px behind player on respawn.
behaviorRegistry.observableEvidence: Math.abs((zyx.y - wave.y) - 350) < 1.0 upon respawn.
behaviorRegistry.playerAcceptanceRequirement: Fair chance to recover after a mistake without instant death.

behaviorRegistry.description: Invulnerability shield granted for 2.5s post-respawn.
behaviorRegistry.observableEvidence: plasmaShield > 0 prevents death upon contact for 2.5s.
behaviorRegistry.playerAcceptanceRequirement: Protection during the disorientation immediately following respawn.

behaviorRegistry.description: White core edge (3.5px), 26px glow blur, 260px body depth, heat orange palette.
behaviorRegistry.observableEvidence: PLASMA_PRESENTATION constant values match frozen spec.
behaviorRegistry.playerAcceptanceRequirement: Consistent, distinctive visual identity of the interstellar hazard.

behaviorRegistry.description: Parabolic jump arc with flight parameter t in [0, 1] over 0.4s.
behaviorRegistry.observableEvidence: Jump progression t advances smoothly from 0 to 1 over ~24 ticks.
behaviorRegistry.playerAcceptanceRequirement: Crisp, snappy arcade platforming feel.

behaviorRegistry.description: Elastic bounce returning player safely to support row upon wrong answer selection.
behaviorRegistry.observableEvidence: player.bouncing === true, lands back on initial currentRow.
behaviorRegistry.playerAcceptanceRequirement: Second-chance educational recovery loop.

behaviorRegistry.description: Dynamic squash and stretch deformation factors on impact.
behaviorRegistry.observableEvidence: zyx.sx and zyx.sy values oscillate upon landing.
behaviorRegistry.playerAcceptanceRequirement: Mascot character appeal and weight.

behaviorRegistry.description: Countdown timer decrements continuously during gameplay ticks.
behaviorRegistry.observableEvidence: timeLeft decrements monotonically with dt.
behaviorRegistry.playerAcceptanceRequirement: Arcade time pressure.

behaviorRegistry.description: Timer reaching zero triggers timeout death sequence.
behaviorRegistry.observableEvidence: timeLeft <= 0 triggers status transition to DYING.
behaviorRegistry.playerAcceptanceRequirement: Firm deadline forcing quick arithmetic decision making.

behaviorRegistry.description: 30 levels across 6 sectors (5 levels per sector).
behaviorRegistry.observableEvidence: LEVEL_DATABASE.length === 30 and CAMPAIGN_SECTORS.length === 6.
behaviorRegistry.playerAcceptanceRequirement: Complete campaign structure.

behaviorRegistry.description: Sector N requires Sector N-1 to be cleared.
behaviorRegistry.observableEvidence: canSelectCampaignSector returns false for locked sectors.
behaviorRegistry.playerAcceptanceRequirement: Standard campaign progression gating.

behaviorRegistry.description: Review mode + unlock override allows playing any level regardless of lock state.
behaviorRegistry.observableEvidence: canSelectCampaignLevel returns true for all 30 levels under review unlock override.
behaviorRegistry.playerAcceptanceRequirement: Quality assurance and teacher review access.

behaviorRegistry.description: Review mode sessions strictly never write to persistent campaign progress.
behaviorRegistry.observableEvidence: Cleared sectors in localStorage unchanged after completing level in review mode.
behaviorRegistry.playerAcceptanceRequirement: Review exploration must not taint legitimate player campaign progress.

behaviorRegistry.description: Settings modal accessible and interactive from Title, Campaign, Ready, and Playing screens.
behaviorRegistry.observableEvidence: Clicking settings button opens modal with data-ui event isolation.
behaviorRegistry.playerAcceptanceRequirement: Always accessible configuration and volume controls.

behaviorRegistry.description: Telemetry collection and export is strictly observational and cannot alter simulation state or outcomes.
behaviorRegistry.observableEvidence: Simulation checksums identical with telemetry enabled vs disabled.
behaviorRegistry.playerAcceptanceRequirement: Diagnostics must have zero impact on gameplay performance or fairness.

behaviorRegistry.description: Procedural Web Audio synthesis for jump, land, bounce, chime, fanfare, and wave hum.
behaviorRegistry.observableEvidence: Synthesizer nodes trigger without external audio asset downloads.
behaviorRegistry.playerAcceptanceRequirement: Responsive audio cues synced to platforming events.

behaviorRegistry.description: Intercept double-tap zoom, pinch-to-zoom, and rubber-band drag on canvas element.
behaviorRegistry.observableEvidence: touch-action: none applied and non-passive gesture prevention active.
behaviorRegistry.playerAcceptanceRequirement: Solid arcade feel on touch devices without accidental browser scrolling.

behaviorRegistry.description: Visual calibration and plasma probe overlays for development tuning.
behaviorRegistry.observableEvidence: calibrationMode flag and calibration UI overlays.
behaviorRegistry.playerAcceptanceRequirement: Internal tooling only.

behaviorRegistry.description: Background music soundtrack playback during arcade rounds.
behaviorRegistry.observableEvidence: Currently absent from production runtime.
behaviorRegistry.playerAcceptanceRequirement: Requires player review before integration.

behaviorRegistry.description: Dynamic background bleed vs solid matte letterboxing on ultrawide mobile viewports.
behaviorRegistry.observableEvidence: Black letterbox matte currently active.
behaviorRegistry.playerAcceptanceRequirement: Requires design signoff.

behaviorRegistry.description: Historical defect where platform hitbox was concentrated around text label, making platform wings unclickable.
behaviorRegistry.observableEvidence: Defect status: REPAIRED_CONTRACTED. PlatformHitGeometry now tests full visual body.
behaviorRegistry.playerAcceptanceRequirement: Must NOT be re-introduced or codified into commercial parity.

behaviorRegistry.description: Historical defect where diagonal route rows clipped outside left/right viewport boundaries.
behaviorRegistry.observableEvidence: Actionable row framing check catches clipping. Commercial camera must dynamically preserve margins.
behaviorRegistry.playerAcceptanceRequirement: Must NOT be codified as required legacy behavior.

behaviorRegistry.description: Historical defect where camera prematurely aimed at row N+1 prior to landing on row N.
behaviorRegistry.observableEvidence: Defect status: REPAIRED_CONTRACTED. Camera now stays anchored to currentRow upon landing.
behaviorRegistry.playerAcceptanceRequirement: Must NOT be re-introduced.
